additional_supported_gaps: F1: sessions are never deleted, including on DELETE, so memory grows and terminated sessions stay reusable (routes.mjs:5,12,21-25). This is a real but low-severity, conditional issue.
F2: the bearer check uses non-constant-time `!==` and has no throttling (routes.mjs:7).
No lockfile is supplied, and Express advisories were not checked. The report records both as unverified rather than alleging a defect.
